title.narrative: Building SADC Science Journalism Capacity to Strengthen Regional Cooperation and Diplomacy

description.narrative: Building on the recommendations of the June 2023 SADC Joint Meeting of Ministers responsible for Education and Training and Science, Technology and Innovation (ET-STI), which called for regular capacity-building initiatives on science communication, UNESCO-ROSA, in collaboration with the SADC Secretariat and regional partners, will support annual science communication training programmes for journalists, media practitioners, and SADC national media coordinators. The activity aims to strengthen the quality and effectiveness of science reporting in Southern Africa by enhancing journalists’ understanding of complex scientific and technological issues affecting the continent, including climate change, health, biodiversity, emerging technologies, and sustainable development.
